briefing: Friend of the cause, well met on {HERE}. I am {PATRON}, and before I name a single fee, I promise you my gratitude runs deep and does not fade.
A truce paper must reach a neighbour world before the old quarrel flares again, and then you must see me safely to the meeting itself, aboard my Boa.
Do this and you will find {PATRON} generous past the fee alone: favours owed, doors opened, and a friend at {HERE} for as long as you fly.
dossier.lead: Word comes that {PATRON} wants a word with her at {WORLD}.

paper.arrive: Take the truce paper to {TARGET} for {PAY}
paper.fail: The paper never reached {TARGET}, and {PAY} stays unpaid

convoy.arrive: See my Boa safely into range at {TARGET} for {PAY}
convoy.success: The Boa reached {TARGET} safely, and {PAY} is yours
convoy.fail: The Boa never reached {TARGET}, and {PAY} goes unpaid

salvage.arrive: Scoop the strongbox adrift near {TARGET} for {PAY}
salvage.success: The strongbox came aboard at {TARGET}, and {PAY} is yours
salvage.fail: The strongbox slipped away near {TARGET}, and {PAY} goes unpaid

rumour.far: Traders say {PATRON} at {WORLD} is buying goodwill with fine words and finer pay.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD}: the truce paper waits, friend, and so does the fee.

dossier.news: News circles say {PATRON} at {WORLD} still seeks a pilot willing to fly a truce.
dossier.title: The Envoy's Passage

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the mission was complete, and {WORLD} lay behind her.
